title: coleogeton filiformis subsp. alpinus
intro: Coleogeton filiformis subsp. alpinus, commonly known as New Zealand swamp cabbage, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coleogeton filiformis subsp. alpinus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. However, more research is needed to confirm the bioactive constituents responsible for these properties, which are likely to include compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
